decisions.rationale: Tyranitar+Excadrill lead: Sand Stream overwrites Drizzle, denying Swift Swim Basculegion and rain Weather Ball, chips 5 of 6 foes, and Sand Rush pushes Excadrill to ~216 Speed, outrunning even Mega Delphox. decisions.notebook:

Game 1 bring: Tyranitar + Excadrill lead, Gholdengo + Sinistcha back.
Key durable notes: Sand overwrites Drizzle -> no SwiftSwim, no rain Weather Ball boost; sand also boosts TTar SpD. Excadrill in sand ~216 Spe beats Mega Delphox 204. Good as Gold immunizes Gholdengo to Taunt/Encore/status. Gholdengo IS weak to Last Respects (Ghost hits Ghost SE) which grows per fainted foe - avoid letting their team faint first. Sinistcha Heatproof resists Heat Wave, walls Water/Ground/Electric. Mr. Rime's Fake Out is dead weight while Tsareena is on the field. Mega Floette is spare special engine but Fairy is resisted by Whimsicott/Metagross/Delphox; low priority.
Watch: Prankster Tailwind flip vs our sand speed; Whimsicott FocusSash means it survives one hit - use spread moves (Rock Slide/Make It Rain) to break sash then finish.

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott + Politoed to establish speed and weather control immediately. Basculegion is preserved to exploit rain after positioning, while Metagross gives the strongest coverage into Floette, Tyranitar, Mr. Rime, Gholdengo, and Excadrill without relying on rain-weakened Fire damage.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 preview selection: prioritize Whimsicott/Politoed lead with Basculegion and Metagross in back. Metagross is preferred over Delphox when broad coverage into Floette, Tyranitar, Mr. Rime, Gholdengo, and Excadrill is needed. Watch for Mr. Rime Fake Out delaying Tailwind; Tsareena is the alternative lead support if repeated Fake Out pressure becomes central in later games.

decisions.rationale: Double Rock Slide: Excadrill (216 in sand) moves first, breaks Whimsicott's Focus Sash and chips Politoed, then Tyranitar's STAB Rock Slide finishes Whimsicott and adds 22-42% to Politoed (~43-82% total plus sand). This removes their Prankster Tailwind/Encore/Taunt engine immediately while pressuring the rain setter, with two shots at a flinch. Single-target lines can't break the sash and KO in the same turn.

reflections.summary: The game was lost because the rain/Tailwind four devoted redundant support to speed control but lacked a durable endgame answer to Life Orb Excadrill; after resources went into removing Gholdengo, Excadrill survived and cleaned. No Mega Stone holder was brought or evolved, so the preview plan also left potential power unused.
reflections.adjustment: At preview, favor a four with a stronger direct Excadrill matchup rather than stacking Tailwind with Swift Swim. In-game, preserve Politoed to overwrite sand and focus Excadrill earlier, using Prankster Encore to punish its Protect or repeated Rock Slide when available.
